notes.problem: The subject is crowded into the top third: rail, hands and doctor are cropped at the top edge over a large empty stretch of wood, with a diagonal purple slab behind the headline. Hands and hair are crude kit meshes.
notes.fix: Tighten the camera so the reading bridge, the card rail and the doctor's hand putting the pen down on the front gold-flagged card fill the upper two thirds. Cut the empty wood and the diagonal slab, and seat the headline on the tone's wash.

notes.problem: No dominant subject, rail in the top fifth, smudge washes behind pills.
notes.fix: Pull the camera back and down so the rail and hands cross the middle half, pills on their objects, no smudge washes.

notes.problem: Mostly empty wood grain, pills float in a dead middle third, type on a diagonal purple plate.
notes.fix: Pull the camera down and in so the rail and hands fill the upper two thirds, seat each pill on its object, seat the headline in the desk's shadow.

notes.problem: Stock kit figures seen from behind, small in the middle band, flat clothing, and a saturated green canopy and lawn that leave the deck's plum and apricot palette, so it reads as another product.
notes.fix: Drop the camera to chest height about twice as close, so the seven figures fill the middle band and the eighth steps out from the oak with an apricot rim. Push the canopy and grass toward olive and plum under a low apricot key, with long plum shadows.

notes.problem: Mannequin figures, torn hair, green out of palette.
notes.fix: Regrade toward violet and magenta, fix hair, turn two figures three quarters.

notes.problem: Stock avatar figures from behind and a blocky trunk, out of the deck's material vocabulary.
notes.fix: Bring the figures and ground into the deck's material language.

notes.problem: Every block holds a gold nodule so the share is invisible, block bases near black.
notes.fix: Make the split read from the picture and lift the block bases with a violet bounce.

notes.problem: All three lung cases carry a gold nodule, so it reads 3 of 3 and nothing tells the screening scan from the incidental ones.
notes.fix: Give the two nodule cases distinct non screening scan shapes so the share reads without the text.

notes.problem: The glass lung fills about a third of the frame at lower right, the upper left is a flat violet wash under the type, and the three panes read as floating frames rather than scan fields cutting the lung.
notes.fix: Pull the camera in and up so the lung fills at least half the frame and rises behind the dek. Inside each pane, render the lung as a lit cross-section with a crisp cut edge and the pane's shadow on the glass, leaving the lung outside the panes plainly unscanned.

notes.problem: The lung group fills a quarter of the frame, a visible type plate, empty salmon upper right.
notes.fix: Scale the group to the right two thirds bleeding off right and bottom, seat the type without a hard rectangle.

notes.problem: The rule, bead and enamel slab sit in the bottom quarter under a large empty sky, so the age comparison is small at 432 px.
notes.fix: Lower the camera and run the rule diagonally from the near-left foreground, with the bead and its '20' at least a quarter of the frame wide, back to the 50 to 80 slab, so the rule fills the lower half.

notes.problem: Ruler crowded into the bottom third under the footer, ticks past the sourced range.
notes.fix: Push in so the ruler runs through the frame centre, label only 20, 50 and 80.

notes.problem: Fake glyph text breaks up close and the flat stack has no single focal subject.
notes.fix: Greeked bars, a low tilted camera, the gold strip lifting off the top sheet.

notes.problem: Both hands merge into a stubby clump behind the lifted card, the window is a flat slab, and the card queue does not read as ranked.
notes.fix: Re-pose one hand as a thumb and two fingers pinching the front card's top edge, with a gap and a plum contact shadow under it. Step the cards visibly lower from front to back so the queue reads as a priority order.
